title: Small Gods
author: Terry Pratchett
summary: In the Discworld country of Omnia, the god Om is stuck in the body of a tortoise because almost nobody truly believes in him. His only believer is Brutha, a novice in a powerful and cruel church.
readIf: you like witty fantasy that pokes at religion, belief and power.
skipIf: you want a serious religious novel or an earnest, non-satirical fantasy.
